overview.mechanism: Modulates cholinergic signaling through acetylcholinesterase inhibition and effects on acetylcholine release, enhancing upper gastrointestinal motility.
uses: Meal-related symptoms of functional dyspepsia, particularly postprandial distress syndrome, as described in clinical studies.

paragraphs.text: The development program studied functional dyspepsia rather than structural gastrointestinal disease. The pharmacology differs from dopamine-antagonist prokinetics.

A randomized study compared extended-release and conventional acotiamide formulations. Trial results do not make release formulations interchangeable and do not establish kidney-failure or dialysis dosing.
